note:
R123 - research-only reference validator for grouped / pair-matrix league schedule generation (prompt research-20260926-after-receipt3,
package 1). NOT Studio code and not the game's scheduling algorithm: it states the contract a generator's REQUEST and its PROPOSED ROWS
must satisfy, as named invariants, and exercises them on fixed vectors and on every shipped league table.

Request (JSON-like dict):
  source      {db_sha256, table}                     the loaded database and table
  slot_map    {fingerprint, members: [slot, ...]}     the CURRENT slot map (slot = league rank by team-table index)
  mapping_fingerprint                                 the fingerprint the request was built against
  participants [slot, ...]                            slots that play the generated games; rows touching any other slot are kept verbatim
  quota       {kind: 'partition', groups, within, across} | {kind: 'matrix', counts: [[...]]}  (matrix indexed by participant order)
  phases      optional [{round, quota}, ...]          several blocks, each with its own round tag, dated in order (Austrian PS4 18-21 shape)
  odd_home    'lower_slot' | 'higher_slot' | {"a,b": home_slot}   who hosts the extra game of an odd pair count; required if any count is odd
  stock       optional {db_sha256, fingerprint, two_phase: bool}  present only for the stock-shaped option (R113 contract of this exact source)
  table       {current_records, kept_rows: [row...], slot_width, has_status}
Row: {index, month, day, home, away, round, status?}  (stored encoding: month / day 0-based; season order = month >= 8 first)

Invariants (request):  Q1 matrix square over participants, zero diagonal; Q2 integer >= 0; Q3 symmetric; Q4 total (upper-triangle sum over
all phases) == current_records - len(kept_rows); Q5 partition covers participants exactly once, no empty group; Q6 participants distinct,
>= 2, all in the current slot map; Q7 every slot < 2**slot_width; Q8 mapping fingerprint == current; Q9 stock option: db hash and fingerprint
equal the stock contract; Q10 stock option on a two-phase source must be requested as phases (never flattened to one round tag); Q11 odd
counts need a declared odd_home rule; Q12 every participant has at least one game.
Invariants (proposal):  R1 exactly current_records rows; R2 kept rows unchanged (same values, same positions); R3 index == position;
R4 unordered pair counts == request (zero pairs included), per phase; R5 home / away: even count -> equal split, odd -> the declared side
hosts one more; R6 no self game, every slot is a participant (generated rows); R7 round == the phase's tag on generated rows; R8 status
written only where the field exists (0); R9 no slot plays twice on one date among generated rows (kept / stock rows: warning); R10 every
row of phase k+1 dated after every row of phase k.
Stock replay: each shipped league table is validated as a proposal against a matrix request built from its OWN pair counts, with
participants = members with more than two games (Studio's default rule), odd_home = derived from the stock rows; the stock-only
anomalies (date order, double bookings, uneven home / away splits incl. 3 / 1) are reported as facts about shipped data, never as corruption.
Usage: python r123_schedule_generation_contract.py <r113.json> <out.json>

vectors.vector: V1 valid partition 2x2, within 2 / across 1, odd pairs hosted by the lower slot
V2 valid matrix (3 clubs) with a kept All-Star row; explicit odd hosts
V3 valid two-phase request (round 0 full round robin, round 1 within-group block dated after it)
